title: The two fibre cycle classes of a closed subscheme of a product with the projective line are rationally equivalent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the closed-subscheme form of the projective line argument: for a closed Z in X times P^1 of dimension at most k + 1 whose two fibres have dimension at most k and whose embedded points inside those fibres have dimension below k, the two fibre cycle classes are rationally equivalent on X (statement lines 3403-3417, tag 02S5). The proof runs a coefficient comparison in the local ring of the product at the generic point of a component of the fibre, where the absence of embedded points gives that A/I is Cohen-Macaulay and the dimension bound on the fibre makes the fibre equation a nonzerodivisor, after which an additivity statement over the minimal primes over I finishes the count. The local algebra is the substance, so the claim is H2.
